title: On recurrence relations arising from NRS(2) applied to a cubic polynomial
summary: We prove that the leading coefficient of the "error" terms of NRS(2) applied to a cubic polynomial $f(z)$ with starting point $(-\frac{a_1}{a_2}, -\frac{a_1}{a_2})$ are positive-coefficient rational functions in the zeros of $f(z)$. We express these terms as a sum over combinatorial objects which we call radius-value trees.
